text: {"observations":"Around 1.0-1.4 s there is a harmonic series on about 219/438 Hz with strong upper partials at 1758, 2633, 3070, 3958, 4382 and 4821 Hz (4th to 11th harmonics), a reedy, harmonic-rich spectrum.
